diagnostics.evidence: The patch corrected source precedence but left boolean coercion unchanged; two boolean-domain target cases remained failing.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Enumerate every requirement dimension before selecting a one-field fix.

diagnostics.evidence: The patch handled common false-like strings and precedence but treated every unknown string as true instead of rejecting invalid boolean input.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Use explicit accepted-value sets and validate the complement, not only common examples.

diagnostics.evidence: The patch added consistency and completeness logic but stopped before returning assembled bytes, leaving the central target behavior incomplete.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Reserve time to trace the primary success path end to end before polishing secondary checks.

diagnostics.evidence: Assembly and conflict handling worked, but invalid chunk bounds were accepted and mutated state.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Validate input bounds before any state mutation and include negative-domain checks in the contract checklist.

diagnostics.evidence: The final patch only imported decimal helpers, did not change the calculation, and the trajectory ran no tests.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Do not leave preparatory imports as the final patch; implement and exercise the changed data path.

diagnostics.evidence: The run made eight patch attempts but reached the 15-step limit with no final patch available for evaluation.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Checkpoint a coherent patch before the final budget window and treat remaining steps as verification and repair.

diagnostics.evidence: The ordering fix assumed every injected executor implemented the context-manager protocol, breaking the existing executor-factory contract.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Preserve lifecycle semantics of injected resources and verify test doubles before changing ownership behavior.

diagnostics.evidence: A different bounded scheduling implementation repeated the same context-manager assumption and failed the same injected-executor regressions.
diagnostics.learning_focus: When two implementations fail the same contract seam, elevate that seam to an explicit pre-edit invariant.

diagnostics.evidence: The run edited the repository tests and left an unfinished test function, so independent syntax validation failed before target evaluation.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Avoid modifying tests unless the task requires it and run a final repository-wide syntax check.

diagnostics.evidence: The signature detector distinguished keyword-only calls but did not reject unsupported callable shapes before invocation.
diagnostics.learning_focus: Validate the complete callable contract, including unsupported shapes, before selecting a dispatch mode.

secondary_observations.interpretation: The calls failed cleanly and were not the direct evaluator failure, but they consumed budget and indicate tool-catalog grounding drift.

policy_implications.inspect_tests_before_edit: Not supported as the next mutation: all 10 failed runs already inspected tests before editing.
policy_implications.prefer_search_before_read: Not supported as the next mutation: all 10 failed runs already searched before editing.
policy_implications.max_react_steps: Supported for proposal consideration: one run produced no patch at 15 steps and 10 of 16 total attempts ended at the step limit, but a Validation gate is still required.
policy_implications.experience_priority: Prioritize contract-dimension checklists, injected-resource lifecycle compatibility, checkpointing a coherent patch, and final syntax/regression verification.

interpretation_boundary: All diagnoses are Train-only, evidence-backed engineering inferences. They do not use Validation/Test and do not prove that any proposed mutation will improve resolution.
